title: Image to mesh with core nodes
hook: A sampler again, with a very strange latent, then a step that turns a grid of numbers into triangles. Why one option makes cubes.

verified.claim: The empty latent is [batch, 64, resolution]: a list of tokens, not a grid.
Positive conditioning is the image embedding and negative is zeros of the same shape.
The decoder queries a grid of octree_resolution + 1 points per side, num_chunks at a time.
VoxelToMeshBasic is marked deprecated, and VoxelToMesh offers surface net and basic.
The real voxel_to_mesh on the lab's 32 grid returned 4,620 triangles, the same as the lab.
The real voxel_to_mesh_surfnet on that grid returned 4,728 triangles and the lab's simpler version 4,620, so its surface net is the same idea and not the same code.
Both graphs pass validate_prompt with file menus skipped.
Hunyuan3D 2.0's abstract describes a shape model built on a flow-based diffusion transformer.

unchecked: These graphs were validated and not run: the Hunyuan3D checkpoint is not on our test machine, so we have no output of our own to show.
The graph's steps, cfg and threshold came from a template. We did not test which values are best. The threshold range is the node's, and what values the decoder gives on real shapes wasn't measured.
The picture in this lesson is from ComfyUI's template library, and was not rendered by us.
